q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Let us know if you don't receive it!

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and support for 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team is $8 per user per month, so for 5 people it would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan allows you to save up to 100 notes and use Example Notes on 1 device. Plus is $4/month for unlimited notes on 3 devices, and Team is $8/user/month with shared workspaces. Annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to request a refund. You can reach support at support@example.com.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Unfortunately, since you bought Plus three weeks ago, you are outside of the refund window. Please contact support with your order number if you have further questions.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app. However, Linux users can use the web app.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later. Please refer to the FAQ for supported platforms. If you have further questions, feel free to open a support ticket.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs a connection to function. The mobile and desktop apps do work offline and sync when you reconnect. Please let me know if you have further questions!

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to recover it. I hope this helps!

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, we only support authenticator apps for two-factor authentication. You can find instructions on how to enable it in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication. I hope this helps!

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The free plan allows attachments up to 25 MB per file. Plus and Team plans have a 250 MB limit. I hope this helps!

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep paid features until the end of the current billing period. To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your data is stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: You can contact support by emailing support@example.com. We reply within one business day. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding Example Notes?

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team plans. You can find more details about the plans in the FAQ.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices. It costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. Please contact support at support@example.com and they will be happy to help.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Please contact support@example.com to open a support ticket.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know. However, you can open a support ticket by emailing support@example.com and we will reply within one business day.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don’t know. There is no Linux desktop app currently, but you can use the web app in the meantime. If you’d like to request a feature or open a support ticket, please email support@example.com.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I am sorry, but I can only answer questions about Example Notes. I cannot provide assistance with Python scripts. Would you like to open a support ticket for assistance with Example Notes?

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
